text:
**Bottom Line**

Score: **4/10**. I would **not approve this as-is**.

The code is readable and small, but the repo is not reproducible from source: the documented tiny end-to-end flow fails because required story data is missing. The checked-in demo artifacts can run downstream validation, which masks the broken extraction path. There are also weak compatibility checks around vectors/backend/config, plus several edge cases that fail with raw NumPy/Python errors instead of clear validation.

Tests run after installing declared dependencies with `PYTHONPATH=/work`: **6 passed, 1 failed**. The failing test is `tests/test_integration_tiny.py::test_tiny_end_to_end`, caused by missing `data/stories/manifest.json`.

**Concrete Issues**

| Severity | File | Lines | Issue |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| high | `emovec/extract.py` | 23-27 | Tiny extraction always requires external `data/stories`, so the advertised CPU demo and integration test fail in a clean checkout. |
| high | `emovec/data.py` | 24-36 | Story loading has no built-in tiny/demo fallback despite README claiming tiny mode can run locally end-to-end. |
| high | `tests/test_integration_tiny.py` | 12-18 | The main end-to-end test currently fails because its fixture data is not present in the repository. |
| medium | `outputs/tiny_demo/vectors/manifest.json` | 25-67 | Checked-in artifacts reference source story metadata that is not checked in, making results non-reproducible. |
| medium | `emovec/validate_contexts.py` | 21-28 | Validation loads vector artifacts and instantiates a backend from CLI config without checking backend, layer count, or vector dimensional compatibility. |
| medium | `emovec/steer_prefs.py` | 26-36 | Preference steering has the same missing artifact/backend/dimension compatibility checks and can silently use the wrong runtime backend. |
| medium | `emovec/config.py` | 56-60 | Negative `token_start` values are accepted and become negative NumPy slices during extraction. |
| medium | `emovec/validate_contexts.py` | 26-28 | If a manifest contains no emotions with built-in scenarios, validation crashes with `ValueError: need at least one array to stack`. |
| medium | `emovec/model.py` | 243-250 | HF residual extraction tokenizes arbitrary full text without truncation or max-length checks, risking model/context errors or memory blowups. |
| medium | `emovec/model.py` | 306-308 | HF preference scoring assumes `" good"` and `" bad"` are single-token labels and uses only the first token if they are not. |
| low | `emovec/config.py` | 42-54 | Empty emotion/topic/story counts are accepted until later code fails with unrelated missing-file or reduction errors. |
| low | `pyproject.toml` | 10-23 | Dependencies are only lower-bounded and there is no lockfile, so future dependency releases can change behavior unexpectedly. |

Estimated rewrite/significant-change scope: **~260 lines**. Most of that is adding a real built-in tiny dataset or generator, schema/config validation, artifact compatibility checks, clearer errors, and tests around those paths.
